record.field: {{ ctx.get('code') }} is your {{ object.website_id.name }} verification code
Sent to customers who sign up on the website, to confirm their email

div.style: margin:0; padding:24px 0; background-color:#EEEBE6; font-family:Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; color:#1E1B19;

table.style: max-width:480px; margin:0 auto; background-color:#ffffff; border-radius:18px; border-collapse:separate;

td.style: background-color:#7A1F2B; border-radius:18px 18px 0 0; padding:18px 24px; color:#ffffff; font-size:20px; font-weight:bold;

td.p: Enter this code to confirm your email and finish creating your account.

div.style: margin:0 0 16px 0; padding:14px 0; background-color:#F6E9EA; border-radius:12px; text-align:center; font-size:32px; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:8px; color:#7A1F2B;

td.p: The code is valid for 10 minutes.
If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email: no account is created without the code.

tr.td: This is an automatic email, please do not reply.
